d: Launched in Bahrain in November of 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We’re a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

We are looking for a Demi Chef De Partie working alongside the Head Chef to manage daily kitchen activities. This includes supporting with menu preparation, maintaining food quality and freshness, overseeing staff, and monitoring ordering and stocking. For this role, we are seeking candidates with a strong à la carte background. The successful candidate will use their culinary and managerial skills to play a key role in elevating our guest experience and maintaining exceptional standards
q: Must have had previous experience as a DCDP.
Must have a minimum of 5 years of experience within the hospitality and in a dine-in, à la carte, fine dining or casual dining restaurant.
The candidate should have a minimum qualification of a culinary degree or equivalent experience in a Hotel or Restaurant setting
Must be currently present in KSA
Must be a proficient communicator in English
Exceptional proven ability in kitchen management
Ability to divide responsibilities and monitor progress
Up-to-date with culinary trends and optimized kitchen processes
Pleasant personality and able to lead with empathy and patience
